verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs explicitly describe reusable components (groups of layers reused across files) with main-component/copy linking so edits to the main propagate to instances, and even a recovery mechanism if the main is deleted — covering the 'stay linked to source' half of the story well. However, evidence for per-instance 'variants' (formal variant properties/sets like Figma) and granular per-instance overrides is thin/absent, and community feedback explicitly flags that Penpot is 'not on Figma's level yet' specifically 'at variants and states of components,' and one user found components 'difficult to handle.' Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a variants/properties system, clearer description of override mechanics, and independent confirmation that variants work well in practice.
